relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine (Journavx; VX-548), the first selective NaV1.8 voltage-gated sodium channel inhibitor approved by the FDA on 30 January 2025

relationships.subject: DRG nociceptors
relationships.evidence_quote: NaV1.8 channels are expressed almost exclusively in small-diameter dorsal root ganglion (DRG) nociceptors and unmyelinated C-fibers.

relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Among all PTs evaluated, the three highest suzetrigine EB q05 values were observed for abnormal dreams, burning sensation, and paresthesia (EB q05 = 31.16 each).

key_findings: FAERS analysis found 14 suzetrigine-unique signals, mainly sensory disturbances (paresthesia, burning sensation, hypoaesthesia), muscle spasms and pruritus, consistent with peripheral NaV1.8 blockade.
Psychiatric signals (euphoric mood, abnormal dreams) lacked external support and were deprioritized.
